muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /plain sse(Plain(ctx, send))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /fancy sse(Fancy(ctx, send))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Plain keeps the pre-options callback shape: the variadic is opt-in per
// method signature, so incremental adoption works route by route.
func (Server) Plain(_ context.Context, send func(string) error) {
	_ = send("plain")
}

func (Server) Fancy(_ context.Context, send func(msg string, opts ...SSEEventOption) error) {
	_ = send("fancy", WithEvent("styled"))
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("plain callback keeps working", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/plain", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "data: plain\n\n"; !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("variadic callback takes options", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/fancy", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "event: styled\ndata: fancy\n\n"; !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})
}
